description: IPC for the computer use session panel only (ADR-0047 decision 6, #1584), named by its WEBVIEW label `computer-panel`: the bundled UI at `#computer-panel`, always on top while a session runs. It reads the session's state and presses Pause, Resume and Stop (`computer_session`), and listens to `computer://event`. Nothing else: no workspace, fetch, opener or window permission.
